title: General cq-state comparison of hypothesis-testing and partially smoothed min-entropies
summary: Compare conditional hypothesis-testing entropy with partially trace-distance-smoothed conditional min-entropy for general classical-quantum states.

formal_statement.body: Let $\rho_{XE}=\sum_x p_x |x\rangle\!\langle x|\otimes\rho_E^x$ be a finite-dimensional cq state. Establish bounds or an equivalence between the source-defined conditional hypothesis-testing entropy $H_h^{\varepsilon}(X|E)_\rho$ and partially trace-distance-smoothed conditional min-entropy $H_{\min}^{\varepsilon,\mathrm{part},T}(X|E)_\rho$ beyond the classical or commuting cases. The comparison should hold for every admissible cq state and error parameters and be sharp enough to determine the associated asymptotic relation.

scope.domain: Privacy amplification against quantum side information and one-shot entropy measures
assumptions: Trace-distance partial smoothing keeps the conditioning marginal fixed according to the source and its antecedent
Hypothesis-testing and smoothing error conventions are those of the source
scope.unresolved_remainder: A general quantum cq-state comparison is unknown beyond the classical or commuting cases. Modified or measured smooth max-relative entropy results and classical or pure-state strong-converse exponents do not establish the requested fixed-marginal partially smoothed conditional-min-entropy comparison.

progress.summary: The source identifies comparison of the two conditional entropy measures in the quantum case as an open question after citing the known classical relation.
